bead.title: Sqlite relational recover-from-log
bead.description:
PROBLEM
`SqliteRelationalBackend` still describes the relational projection as DB-authoritative and its reopen path as replay-free, so the sqlite relational family cannot be rebuilt from the durable log tail.
ROOT CAUSE
`crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs:1691-1693, 4039-4040, 8425-8428, 9330-9335` still says the item projection is already durable, the backend is DB-authoritative, and recovery only repopulates control-plane state and counters.
PROPOSED FIX
Persist the sqlite relational applied high-water, make `recovery_high_water` return the applied position, and update the reopen/composed recovery path so sqlite relational state is restored by replaying the durable log tail instead of treating `pqueue_items` as authoritative.
NON-SCOPE
postgres family changes, shared compose wiring, conformance-suite expansion, docs wording cleanup, and the `pqueue-b59f4897` TOCTOU prerequisite fix.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestSqliteRelationalRecoveryHighWater` proves `SqliteRelationalBackend::recovery_high_water` returns the applied position after a truncate/reopen cycle.
2. `TestSqliteRelationalTruncateThenRecoverExactState` reproduces exact acknowledged state on sqlite relational for items, leases, counters, idempotency, fences, and metrics.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite --test relational_conformance` and `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite --test composed_relational_reconnect` pass for the sqlite relational path.
4. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
